name: Gemini API Developer
audience: Developers building apps and agents on Gemini
format: This site's course: 40-question practice test in 60 minutes. Google has no matching certification; for an official credential see Professional Machine Learning Engineer.
scenarios: Support assistant with live order data
verifyNotes: This is the site's own course; Google has no matching exam. Verify every API fact against aistudio.google.com/docs (formerly ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs) and the ADK docs: current model names and aliases, the Interactions API vs legacy generateContent, thinking levels, tool_choice modes, structured output schema support, grounding billing/display rules, caching and Batch pricing, rate-limit tiers. Mark previews as previews.

domains.name: Models & the Interactions API
skills: Choose a Gemini model (Pro, Flash, Flash-Lite) by quality, latency and cost
Handle aliases, previews and deprecations
Call Gemini with the Interactions API; steps, server-side state and stateless mode
Know the legacy generateContent API and when you meet it

domains.name: Prompting & multimodal input
skills: Write effective Gemini prompts and system instructions
Set thinking levels and sampling parameters on current models
Send images, audio, video and PDFs; use the Files API for large or reused media
Prompt well with media inputs

domains.name: Function calling & structured output
skills: Run the function-calling loop end to end
Use tool_choice modes and parallel/compositional calls
Design clear tool declarations
Produce JSON with response schemas; know what schemas can't enforce; validate and retry

domains.name: Grounding, RAG & long context
skills: Ground answers with Google Search, Maps and URL context; follow display and billing rules
Choose long context vs retrieval
Build RAG with Gemini embeddings
Prompt over long context (documents first, question last)

domains.name: Agents: ADK, Managed Agents & Agent Platform
skills: Build agents with the Agent Development Kit: agents, tools, sessions, multi-agent
Use Google-managed agents via the Interactions API
Deploy agents on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform

domains.name: Cost, performance & production
skills: Cut cost with implicit and explicit caching, the Batch API and token counting
Handle rate limits, tiers, errors and retries with backoff
Stream responses and run long work in the background

domains.name: Safety & responsible AI
skills: Configure safety settings and read block reasons
Apply responsible-AI practices beyond filters
